name: Yaroslav Amosov
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: The former Bellator welterweight champion from Ukraine (30-1, age 33), training at American Top Team. He is 2-0 in the UFC with submissions of Neil Magny (R1, December 2025) and Joel Alvarez (R2, May 2026). His only loss was a R3 knockout by Jason Jackson in 2023.

how_they_fight.Striking: Functional and heavy-handed; nine knockouts in our data (six in R1).
how_they_fight.Grappling: A chain wrestler and sambo player who controls from top. Thirteen submissions in our data, nine of them in R1.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has gone five rounds twice (Lima, Storley) and won both.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Patient; takes the fight where he wants it.

patterns: Takedowns and top control; submissions mostly in R1
concerns: Only stopped by a striker who could keep it standing (Jackson)
First fight against a top-five welterweight
keys_to_beat: Keep it standing with footwork and takedown defence
